title: Greg Brown, Chairman and CEO, Motorola Solutions to Participate in the 2026 UBS Global Technology & AI Conference
summary: Motorola Solutions today announced that Greg Brown, Chairman and CEO, will participate in the upcoming UBS Global Technology & AI Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 3:35 p.m. MT.
body_markdown:
CHICAGO – Nov. 23, 2026 – Motorola Solutions (NYSE: MSI), a global leader in mission-critical technologies for public safety, defense and enterprise organizations, today announced that Greg Brown, Chairman and CEO, will participate in the upcoming UBS Global Technology & AI Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 3:35 p.m. MT.


A live webcast and replay of the session will be featured on Motorola Solutions’ Investor Relations website at[www.motorolasolutions.com/investor](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/investor) .


**About Motorola Solutions | Solving for safer** Safety and security are at the heart of everything we do at Motorola Solutions. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Learn more about our commitment to innovating for a safer future for us all at[www.motorolasolutions.com](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/) .
